title: The Volume Uplift in the Circle Points Rate
content:
The volume uplift added into the rate at which reward points on a Northbeam Circle Membership are earned
is read from the qualifying spend booked on the membership in the twelve months ending on the handling day and
the earning occasions standing in that window.

## The uplift

1. Where the qualifying spend booked in the twelve months ending on the handling day reaches the qualifying
   spend figure of the tier and four or more earning occasions stand in that window, the volume uplift is the
   loyal rate uplift of this schedule, 0.5 points per USD.
2. Where that spend reaches the mid spend share of the qualifying spend figure of the tier — one half, 50
   percent, of it — but not the figure itself, and two or more earning occasions stand in that window, the
   volume uplift is the middle rate uplift of this schedule, 0.25 points per USD.
3. Where neither of those holds, there is no volume uplift, and 0 points per USD go into the rate on this
   account.

## The tier figure the readings turn on

| Tier | Qualifying spend figure (USD) | One half of that figure (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Circle Free Membership | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Circle Plus Annual | 2500.00 | 1250.00 |
| Circle Total Annual | 9000.00 | 4500.00 |
| Circle Total Household Annual | 9000.00 | 4500.00 |
| Circle Business Pro | 40000.00 | 20000.00 |
| Circle Business Elite | 250000.00 | 125000.00 |

## Both sides of each boundary

On Circle Plus Annual, qualifying spend of 2500.00 with 4 earning occasions in the window reaches the tier's
figure and the count, so 0.5 points per USD go into the rate. The same spend with 3 occasions reaches neither
reading: the first wants four occasions and the second wants the spend to fall below the tier's figure. Spend
of 2499.99 with 3 occasions reaches one half of 2500.00 and two occasions, so 0.25 goes in. Spend of 1249.99
reaches neither half nor whole, and nothing goes in.
